title: ScriptDefinition
description: Schema for a Kotlin Scripting user-code unit (ADR-005): Trigger, Batch job, Scheduled job, or Invocable Action. A script can never be activated (isActive=true) while compileErrors is non-empty.

triggerEvent.description: Required when kind is TRIGGER, otherwise null.

invocableName.description: Required when kind is INVOCABLE_ACTION — the name callable from declarative Flows/automations.

scheduleCron.description: Required when kind is SCHEDULED — standard cron expression.

source.description: Kotlin source. Compiled and cached on save (ADR-005) — never recompiled per execution.

isActive.description: Can only be set true after a clean compile. AI-generated scripts default to false and require explicit human activation.

timeoutSeconds.description: Tenant can only tighten this below the platform default, never loosen beyond the hard ceiling (30s).

generatedByAi.description: Audit flag — true if this script's source originated from an AI proposal (ADR-005 'AI integration').
